Interface TapeListener

All Superinterfaces:
FileLoader.Listener
public interface TapeListener extends FileLoader.Listener
Tape signal callbacks, decoded from TAP/TZX blocks by FileLoader.

Usage: FileLoader.load(path, format, tapeListener). Pulse lengths are in Z80 T-states (3.5 MHz), bits are sent from the most significant one. Blocks which cannot be played are reported by onInfo(String, String).

    • onBlock

      default void onBlock(FileLoader.Block block) throws IOException
      Decodes a tape block into the callbacks of this listener. TZX control-flow blocks are ignored here (the loader follows them).
      Specified by:
      onBlock in interface FileLoader.Listener
      Parameters:
